metadata.description: Decision Desk: five decision skills for Claude (frame, compare, go/no-go, pre-mortem, review); no fact about your options is invented, the weights are yours, and the flip point is always named.

plugins.name: decision-desk
plugins.description: See a real decision clearly from what you actually know: frame a tangled choice, compare named options in a weighted matrix where every score has its source and the weights are yours to change, get a go/no-go with the cheapest test first, stress-test a plan before you commit, and rescore when something changes. No fact about your options is invented, and what would flip the answer is always named.
